answer: Sustained Attention Prism.** Each identity must continuously solve fresh, context-bound micro-tasks whose answers feed a live validation stream, so effort spent on one identity cannot be reused elsewhere—the prism splits attention into non-transferable channels. Enforcement: missed or wrong submissions decay standing below a canyon threshold, expiring the identity. An attacker provisioning N sybils pays N parallel attention streams, since a mirror of prior answers fails the freshness check, making each fake identity cost real continuous human labor.
